items.stemEn: The ice on the lake began to ____ when spring came.
items.stemZh: 春天來了，湖上的冰開始融化。

items.stemEn: The cat and the mouse ran around the house in a wild ____.
items.stemZh: 貓和老鼠在屋裡展開一場激烈的追逐。

items.passageEn: Our school basketball team had never defeated the team from the school across town. But this year, things changed. The coach composed a team song, and we sang it before every game. Our success stemmed from hard work and great team spirit. On the day of the final, it was so hot that the ice in our drinks melted in minutes. Before the game, the ball felt soft, so the coach used a pump to fix it. In the last minute, there was a wild chase for the ball, and our captain got it and scored. Nobody could believe it at first: we had won by two points! The next day, the local newspaper highlighted our hard work.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的籃球隊從來沒有打敗過城另一頭那所學校的球隊。但今年情況變了。教練寫了一首隊歌，我們每場比賽前都會唱。我們的成功源於努力和很棒的團隊精神。決賽那天熱到飲料裡的冰塊幾分鐘就融化了。比賽前，球摸起來軟軟的，所以教練用打氣筒把它打飽氣。最後一分鐘，大家激烈地追著球搶，我們的隊長搶到球並得分。一開始大家都不敢置信：我們贏了兩分！第二天，當地報紙特別強調了我們的努力。

questions.questionZh: 比賽前教練用打氣筒做什麼？

items.promptZh: 他們在決賽中擊敗了我們。
referenceEn: They defeated us in the final.
They defeated us in the final game.
rubricZh: defeat 表示「擊敗」，例如 defeat someone in… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 我弟弟不敢一個人睡覺。
referenceEn: My little brother doesn't dare to sleep alone.
My younger brother dare not sleep by himself.
rubricZh: 用 dare 表示「敢」（例如 doesn't dare to sleep、dare not sleep 等）
「一個人」可寫，例如 alone、by himself 等
